name: Fenix A32X (MSFS)
_comment: Variable names confirmed against a live Fenix A320 IAE.
Fenix reports these in THOUSANDS of psi - the accumulator read 3.24 and
the brakes 2.103 with the park brake set - so scale is 1000 to get psi.
The dial face is marked PSI x 1000 and divides by 1000 again for the
needle, which is why the numbers look circular. They are not: the wire
protocol carries psi so a future panel with a different scale still works.
Fenix prefixes are short: N_ for numeric, B_ for boolean, S_ for switch,
CB_ for circuit breakers. N_HYD_PRESSURE_BRAKE_ACCU is the whole name.
